primary_objective: Land the rocket safely on the pad at coordinates (0,0) minimizing fuel consumption and time.

objective_decomposition.goal: Counteract initial random force and align vertical axis.
Reduce altitude while maintaining horizontal position near pad.
Achieve zero velocity at contact with both legs on the pad.

behavior_trajectory_alignment.goal: Counteract initial random force and align vertical axis.
Reduce altitude while maintaining horizontal position near pad.
Achieve zero velocity at contact with both legs on the pad.

metric_priority: Cumulative episode return (sum of step rewards)
primary_selection_metric: Cumulative episode return (sum of step rewards)
diagnostic_metrics: Landing stability (duration of leg contact before termination)
success_criteria: Both legs in contact with ground (state[6] == 1.0 and state[7] == 1.0)
Position within landing pad bounds (abs(state[0]) < threshold)

failure_modes.name: Infinite Hovering
failure_modes.description: Agent hovers indefinitely to avoid crash penalty without landing.

failure_modes.name: Crash Avoidance via Escape
failure_modes.description: Agent flies out of bounds intentionally if boundary exit is less penalized than crash.

failure_modes.name: Oscillation
failure_modes.description: Agent oscillates near pad without committing to landing due to sparse reward.

bad_local_optima.name: Infinite Hovering
bad_local_optima.description: Agent hovers indefinitely to avoid crash penalty without landing.

reward_generator_constraints: Success reward must exceed maximum possible accumulated step penalties.
Crash penalty should be immediate and significant to discourage risky behavior.
Fuel cost per step should be small enough not to prevent landing but large enough to encourage efficiency.
Reward shaping for proximity to pad is recommended due to sparse success signal.
